name: Wristkey
tagline: Get your 2-step login codes right on your smartwatch
description:
Wristkey is a free, open-source 2FA app built for smartwatches running Wear OS. It generates the same kind of time-based codes as apps like Aegis or Google Authenticator, but keeps them a glance away on your wrist instead of buried in your phone.

It supports scanning QR codes to add accounts, so it can fit alongside other authenticator apps you may already use.
